message.content:
We are given that Suzanne made 36 cookies. Josh made one-fourth the number of cookies that Suzanne made, so:

$$
\text{Josh's cookies} = \frac{1}{4} \times 36 = 9
$$

Kelsie made two times more cookies than Josh, so:

$$
\text{Kelsie's cookies} = 2 \times 9 = 18
$$

FINAL_ANSWER: 18
